shortDescription: Attempts to determine the version of a package to be installed or already installed.

options.name: package_name
options.description: Package name which is searched for in the system or via the package management.

options.name: repository
options.description: Name of the repository in which the search is being conducted. This is only necessary for RedHat-based distributions.

options.name: state
options.description: The status of a package. Defines whether the version of an already installed (C(installed)) package or the version of a package available for installation (C(available)) is output.
